name: Runner Extras - Windows Language License Stub
brief: Issue #2581: the six license-derived and four installed-resource columns of the Windows Language virtual table (2000000045) have no source on the runner, so their values are CHOSEN. This suite pins the choice so it cannot change silently.
description: What the Windows Language table says about a language - its name, tag, abbreviated name and OEM code page - is plain BC behaviour and is covered upstream in the al-language corpus. This suite deliberately asserts none of that. It asserts only what exists because this is the runner: that the license-derived columns answer permitted, and that the installed-resource columns answer none. Both are declared divergences, not faithful substitutions - real BC has no no-license answer to copy, since get_License() throws. See docs/limitations.md and the header of AlRunner/Patches/RecordPatches.WindowsLanguageVirtualTable.cs.
